svg.aria-label: How to write ண: 2 strokes · 1 pen lift · 7 movements
svg.title: Writing ண
svg.desc: 7 frames; frame N shows movements 1 to N of ண (tamil), the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansTamil-Static.ttf. Stroke order after Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 13, ண (Univ. of Texas at Austin), p. 195 <https://sites.la.utexas.edu/tamilscript/files/2009/08/hw_lettersinstructions.pdf>. Source note on variation: Tamil handwriting is taught with school-to-school variation; there is no single national stroke-order standard. This is one attested order.
svg.text: How it is written — 2 strokes · 1 pen lift · 7 movements
Stroke order after Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 13, ண (Univ. of Texas at Austin), p. 195
This order is attested, not standardised; the source records where it varies.
